description: Genuine screen-level (pixel) observation of Serum 2's own plugin window, loaded via the corrected single VERIFY_REFERENCE_FULL.SerumPreset (all sections merged: INIT master + 12 simultaneous FX rack slots + OSC_SAMPLE oscillator config). Distinct from host_text_evidence: this is what a human sees on screen.
structural_confirmation: FX page shows all 12 FX types (Bode, Chorus, Compressor, Convolve, Delay, Hyper/Dimension, Distortion, Equalizer, +Filter/Flanger/Phaser/Reverb below the fold) present SIMULTANEOUSLY as distinct rack slots in one preset -- confirms the multi-slot FX merge architecture works as intended, not just in theory.
raw_write_gap_finding: All 4 open findings from the first checkpoint (lfo1.mode, fx.compressor.ratio, fx.compressor.release, env1-4.sustain) are now confirmed genuine MISMATCHes via isolated single-field reproduction tests (see DIRECT_UI_FINDING_RAW_WRITE_GAP.md for full investigation). Common root cause: the causal engine's raw body_set() bypasses serum_mcp's apply_spec() semantic encoder for DIRECT_RAW/ENUM_RAW-mechanism candidates; DawDreamer's session state-readback echoes the raw write back unchanged (looks retained) but does not predict what Serum's native .SerumPreset file loader actually honors. This affects an UNKNOWN subset of the wider 328-candidate population, not just these 4 -- it is the reason the exhaustive DIRECT_UI scan must continue rather than trusting STATE_QUALIFIED_UI_PENDING evidence alone.
